description: Source code implementing serial transport utilities for mcumgr protocol, including CRC calculation, fragment processing, and packet transmission over serial with Base64 encoding.

methods.name: mcumgr_serial_free_rx_ctxt
methods.description: Frees the receive context buffer if allocated.

methods.name: mcumgr_serial_calc_crc
methods.description: Calculates CRC16 checksum for given data.

methods.name: mcumgr_serial_process_frag
methods.description: Processes received fragment, assembles complete packet if possible.

methods.name: mcumgr_serial_tx_small
methods.description: Base64-encodes small data chunks (up to 3 bytes) and transmits via callback.

methods.name: mcumgr_serial_tx_pkt
methods.description: Transmits a packet over serial, splitting into multiple Base64-encoded frames with headers and CRC.
